text:
laura: Heads-up: brought up deepcut13b-int8 on staging. Huge token savings but some weird "completeness" drops on multi-paragraph summarization. Need rapid recommendation for GTN/PM.

josh: numbers?

laura: quick smoke: 
```
fp16 baseline: cost_per_token = $0.011, p95 = 140ms, avg_thpt = 220req/s, conv_rate_proxy = 0.082
int8: cost_per_token = $0.0035, p95 = 155ms, avg_thpt = 240req/s, conv_rate_proxy = 0.073
delta = ~5.9% conversion proxy drop on summit-summaries slice
```

mia: 5.9% conv proxy drop is non-trivial. What's slice definition?

laura: summit-summaries = multi-paragraph meeting notes -> condensed action items + follow-ups. Failures are more omissions (missing key action items) vs hallucination.

rene: For GTN we need: baseline acceptability, expected unit savings, and a traffic routing plan. Also include a simple ROI break-even calc.

laura: ROI calc quick: avg tokens per summary = 1200. savings per token = 0.011 - 0.0035 = 0.0075. per-summary savings = 1200 * 0.0075 = $9.00. If conversion loss costs $15 average LTV per lost conversion, then break-even if <60% relative drop (?) that's fuzzy. Need product to provide LTV per conversion.

josh: minor nit: conversion proxy not equal to final conversion. Recommend A/B on real traffic for 2 weeks. Meanwhile, conservative routing: int8 for low-visibility flows (auto-drafts, background jobs), fp16 for user-facing final summaries.

mia: propose hybrid variant where decoder stays int8 but attention / norm in fp16. Ran a 500-sample check: completeness gap reduced by ~4pp, cost +22% vs int8. Still ~2.3x cheaper than fp16.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary deepcut13b-int8 hybrid in prod-canary (us-east). dashboard: https://internal/dash/models/deepcut13b/canary

rene: Suggested scorecard fields to hand GTN: [variant, cost_per_token, p95_latency, completeness_long_pp, hallucination_pp, conv_proxy_delta, recommended_route, notes]. Keep it one-pager.

laura: assembling scorecard. Also adding a sensitivity table for avg_tokens = [300, 800, 1200] and cost delta per-req.

josh: add routing heuristics: if prompt contains {"type":"final-summary"} or expected_output_tokens > 600 -> route to fp16; if user has >=3 edits in session -> fp16; else hybrid.

mia: ops request: add automatic rollback if completeness_long_pp drops >5pp over a 6-hour window on production slices.

laura: ran a short cost sim (numbers rounded):
```
avg_tokens = 1200
fp16_cost = 1200 * 0.011 = $13.20
int8_cost = 1200 * 0.0035 = $4.20
hybrid_cost ≈ $5.10
savings fp16->int8 = $9.00 per summary
savings fp16->hybrid = $8.10 per summary
```

rene: With these numbers GTN will want an impact table: (savings per summary) x (monthly summaries) - (estimated revenue lost due to quality drop). We'll need product to estimate sensitivity.

josh: next steps: 1) Laura to post scorecard + sample failures (CSV) 2) Mia to run 2k-sample A/B on labeled slices 3) Rene to draft GTN note with routing proposal and break-even scenarios 4) Ops to add rollback monitor.

laura: created INF-2407 linking canary, scorecard, and CSV. Posting preliminary scorecard in a bit. :spiral_notepad: 

mia: quick flag: 500-sample noisy but suggests hybrid is the pragmatic middle-ground. Recommend soft roll: hybrid default, fp16 override for final outputs.

josh: +1. Also include priming/trigger sensitivity in monitoring; some failures were resolved by a single extra priming instruction.

deploy-bot: eval job complete: 500-sample results -> https://internal/evals/deepcut13b/500

laura: summary from 500-sample eval: int8 completeness_long = -8.5pp, hallucination +1.1pp; hybrid completeness_long = -3.9pp, hallucination +0.7pp. p95 latency differences within 10-15ms.

rene: Drafting GTN note now. Aim for decision next week after 2k-sample A/B.

laura: will upload scorecard and attach sample failures to INF-2407. Will cc PMs and GTN.

(misc: these are short internal notes; 500-sample run still noisy, plan larger A/B before full rollout)
